description: The task board moves cards between columns by drag and drop, shows a card's details on hover and loads older history while scrolling. Shoppers rate a product with stars; the ratings chart counts every rating.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropping a card on Done moves it into the Done column and the Done count becomes 1.
Hovering a card shows its owner and due date.
Scrolling the history loads older events down to the first one, H-50.
Clicking the fourth star shows 4 / 5 and adds one rating to the four-star bar of the chart.
